data.title: Thamanat watch fuels govt ties talk
data.description: Speculation over the Klatham Party's political ties with the government has intensified after its leader, Capt Thamanat Prompow, was seen wearing a Casio watch similar to one worn by Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul.

data.title: At UN, OpenAI's Altman calls 'for extreme care' in AI
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - The current moment in AI development "calls for extreme care," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told the UN Security Council on Wednesday, noting that the technology's advancement could accelerate rapidly.

data.title: US judge weighing Trump's White House ban on media outlets
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A US federal judge was holding a hearing on Wednesday to consider a demand by CNN, MS NOW and Politico to have their White House access restored after their credentials were revoked by President Donald Trump.

data.title: Zelensky says Putin using fighters from 47 countries in Ukraine war
data.description: UNITED NATIONS (UNITED STATES) - Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky accused his Russian counterpart Vladimir Putin of using third-country fighters from 47 countries to prosecute Moscow's war against Ukraine.

data.title: Ditch ‘enemy state’ label, Japanese PM tells UN
data.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has called on the United Nations to scrap references to former Axis powers as “enemy states” in its Charter — a World War II-era designation that China and Russia have recently used to attack Tokyo.

data.title: Golan will remain Syrian, president vows at UN
data.description: UNITED NATIONS - Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa insisted at the United Nations on Wednesday that the Golan Heights region will remain Syrian after Colombia last month recognised Israeli sovereignty over the strategically important territory.

data.title: Rights groups press Malaysia to stop Rohingya returns
data.description: ​More than ⁠160 ⁠civil society organisations released a ​joint statement on Wednesday urging Malaysia to halt plans to deport ​Rohingya refugees to Myanmar, citing ‌severe risks of ongoing violence and forced conscription.

data.title: Miss Universe Cambodia team admits error with Thai photos
data.description: The organisers of the Miss Universe Cambodia pageant have acknowledged their use of Thai historical photographs, saying the mistake was unintentional and resulted from “insufficient verification” of the original sources.

data.title: They came, they rode, they conquered
data.description: Thailand ended a 28-year wait for an Asian Games equestrian eventing team title on Wednesday, and backed it up with a clutch of further medals in skeet shooting, badminton, weightlifting and karate at Aichi-Nagoya 2026.

data.title: Russia probes bear attacks in region under ‘siege’
data.description: MOSCOW - At least six people have been killed in bear attacks in Russia’s vast Siberian region of Krasnoyarsk in a month, prosecutors said on Wednesday, as an official in a neighbouring region reported bears had put one town “under siege”.

data.title: Court rejects Yingluck’s appeal for rice-graft retrial
data.description: The Supreme Administrative Court has rejected an appeal by former prime minister Yingluck Shinawatra to retry the case that resulted in an order for her to pay 10 billion baht for losses from a rice-pledging scheme she oversaw more than a decade ago.

data.title: Ashlee Nino revealed as Nene’s drummer in AGT 2026 final
data.description: AGT house drummer Ashlee Nino praises Thai guitarist Nene Royal’s final after fans confuse her with The Warning’s Paulina Villarreal.

data.title: ICC convicts Central Africa rebel leader
data.description: THE HAGUE - The International Criminal Court on Wednesday convicted a former Central African Republic rebel commander on four counts of crimes against humanity including torture and unlawful imprisonment.

data.title: New UK unit to combat disinformation from Russia, AI
data.description: LONDON - The UK will create an agency to fight disinformation coming from adversaries such as Russia and amplified by artificial intelligence, to help “separate fact from fiction”, Britain’s defence minister said Wednesday.

data.title: Inside Bangkok’s World Gourmet Festival, where top chefs share the kitchen
data.description: The 26th World Gourmet Festival returns to Bangkok from Sept 29 to Oct 4, 2026, bringing together some of the world's most distinguished chefs. More than a showcase of gastronomic talent, the event serves as a multicultural narrative rooted in food heritage and transnational exchange - and as a crucible where culinary philosophies clash and meld.

data.title: Xi departs for US for talks with Trump
data.description: BEIJING - China’s leader Xi Jinping departed Beijing on Wednesday, bound for Washington where he will meet with US President Donald Trump, state media said

data.title: UK to revisit Chagos deal after Trump criticism
data.description: LONDON - Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said on Wednesday that Britain would rework its deal with Mauritius to return the remote Chagos Islands, home to a strategic US-UK military base, amid vocal opposition from President Donald Trump.

data.title: Azerbaijan pardons Frenchman after EU lifts sanctions on oligarchs
data.description: BAKU - Azerbaijan’s president on Wednesday pardoned Martin Ryan, a Frenchman jailed since 2023 on espionage charges, following the European Union’s removal of two Russian billionaires from its sanctions list.

data.title: Naked office visit gets school head transferred
data.description: A school director in Chanthaburi has been temporarily transferred to the local primary education office after images surfaced showing him naked inside a school office.

data.title: Feel the chill
data.description: Though Thailand isn’t known for its winter months, you can still be chill. Guru By Bangkok Post has a list of the latest fashion collections for the autumn and winter months, which are wearable no matter where in the world you are.

data.title: Three Chinese women held by compatriots rescued in Chon Buri
data.description: CHON BURI - Three Chinese women were rescued in the early hours of Wednesday after police were alerted that four men of their same nationality allegedly detained them for sexual abuse and extortion at a house in Bang Lamung district.

data.title: Bangkok tackles cable clutter ahead of IMF-World Bank meetings
data.description: Bangkok is stepping up efforts to tackle its long-standing problem of tangled overhead power and communications cables ahead of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank annual meetings next month.

data.title: Heavy rain likely across Thailand until weekend
data.description: Isolated heavy to very heavy rain is forecast over Thailand until Sunday, according to the Meteorological Department, which has urged people to follow weather updates from official sources after an online panic over a “great flood”.

data.title: Sculptors take car design to the limit and beyond
data.description: The Brooklyn-based creative collective MSCHF is turning heads with its transformation of two Lexus electric vehicles into surreal sculptures that appear to have escaped the laws of automotive design.

data.title: Battered Duerer masterpiece up for five-year restoration
data.description: PRAGUE - Albrecht Duerer’s “Feast of the Rosary”, a Renaissance gem of Prague’s National Gallery, is facing a painstaking five-year reconstruction designed to set right five centuries of mistreatment and damage.

data.title: EVA Air Wins Three No. 1 SKYTRAX Awards and 11th Consecutive 5-Star Rating
data.description: TAIPEI, TAIWAN – EVA Air once again earned top honours at the prestigious SKYTRAX World Airline Awards, taking first place in three categories: World’s Best Premium Economy Class, World’s Best Premium Economy Class Airline Amenities, and World’s Most Family Friendly Airline at the prestigious SKYTRAX World Airline Awards. The carrier also retained its coveted SKYTRAX 5-Star Airline rating for the 11th consecutive year, reaffirming its longstanding commitment to excellence in safety and service.

data.title: TOA Launches ‘TOA Wood Expert’ Campaign to Promote Sustainable Wood Care
data.description: As a comprehensive wood-care expert and a leader in eco-friendly paint innovations and construction materials in Thailand, TOA Paint (Thailand) is building on this philosophy with its major annual campaign, “TOA Wood Expert: Caring for Wood Together.” Under the concept “Caring for the Wood at Home Means Caring for the Wood in the Forest,” the campaign encourages Thais to look beyond simply extending the lifespan of wooden products and to embrace more responsible resource consumption and greater environmental awareness.

data.title: Black Sea drone attacks spell terror for Turkish sailors
data.description: They’d just had breakfast when a huge blast brought the crew of the Turkish fishing boat racing out onto main deck, where they were standing when the second strike hit.

data.title: 'Super' El Niño could cause 451,000 excess deaths: research
data.description: SINGAPORE — Extreme ⁠heat ⁠caused by this year's "super-El ​Niño" could result in as many as 451,000 excess deaths ​across the globe in ‌the six months through February 2027, researchers with the University of Chicago's Climate Impact Lab said on Wednesday.

data.title: GRAND’s September 22 plan caps Westin Sukhumvit asset sale at 494.60 million baht
data.description: GRAND says a severe cash shortage led to rent defaults and termination of a land lease at Bangkok’s Westin Grande Sukhumvit hotel.
